intro.title: Build feature flag evaluation endpoint
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple HTTP endpoint in Node.js that evaluates feature flags. You'll learn how to create a server that responds to requests by checking if a feature is enabled based on a user identifier. The core programming concept involves using conditional logic to return different responses. You'll use Node.js's built-in HTTP module to handle incoming requests and send JSON responses. This will give you practical experience with server-side routing and basic API design.
intro.usecase: Feature flag endpoints are essential for modern web applications, allowing teams to roll out new features gradually and safely. For example, a social media platform might use a feature flag endpoint to control whether a new 'stories' UI is visible to users in a specific region. This pattern enables developers to test features on a subset of users, perform A/B testing on dashboards, or quickly disable a problematic feature in production without redeploying code.
